title: DOE-05: Hanford's 2025 decision trail resolves to the 2023 AoA and Addendum 1
publisher: Named U.S. government agencies and the U.S. Government Accountability Office
summary: GAO-24-106989 Recommendation 3 now has a second-order recovery chain for one Phase 56U near-match. The agency-GAO conflict now has a document lineage: 2023 AoA, 2023 Addendum 1, and 2025 supplement. The missing object is no longer a generic Hanford analysis; it is the distinct post-recommendation pause and prerequisite decision package.
